facts.fact: The Ministry of Communication (MCPT) says DFN has deployed over 200 km of fibre in Djibouti-ville and the interior regions, connecting hospitals, schools and public bodies; Ali Sabieh, 90 km south of the capital, has its regional hospital linked by it (document dated by in-text day 24 June 2025; fibre use is institutional, so the backbone reading is uncertain).
